ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails and networks involved in child care fraud, including the Feeding Our Future case
questions: What are the key financial players and networks involved in child care fraud?
How do these networks operate and launder money?
ideas.insight: By following the money and analyzing financial trails, we can uncover the scope and complexity of child care fraud and identify key players and networks. This investigation could lead to further prosecutions and restitution.
